title: Base Power pricing gate
description: A pricing table you can't read yet: a plan card and a pitch sit heavily blurred across the band, and a deep forest-green card with soft shadow floats over the middle with a lime icon, a white heading, a line of copy and a white utility picker.
notes: the blurred preview is real text from props, hidden from screen readers
the picker is a native <select> inside a form (no JavaScript)
name: basepowercompany-pricing-gate

props.name: icon
props.description: a small icon at the top of the card (lucide), shown in lime

props.name: select
props.type: { placeholder: string; label: string; action: string; name?: string | undefined; options: { label: string; value: string; }[]; }
props.description: the utility picker: placeholder, screen-reader label, form action and the choices

props.name: preview
props.description: the pricing that shows, blurred, behind the card (decoration: hidden from screen readers)
